'''Ion mines''' were [[Ion cannon/Legends|ionic]] explosives used as an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defense weapon. They were employed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defense emplacements during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The mines saw use at the [[Battle over Korriban]], where they were made obsolete by the tactics of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Unidentified Republic commodore|commodore]].<ref name="BoE3" /> They were also used by the [[Kalindan Defense System]] as part of their defensive network.<ref name="DS" />
